measurement_only_pair.obligation: During the pulse the negative-bias run must increase pump/blower commands and connected flows relative to the positive-bias run. After bias removal, the resulting real zone-state difference must drive corrective actuator response. A common contemporaneous input feedforward is insufficient.

contract.transparent_mechanism: Evaluator-derived typed/domain paths must jointly prove solar-to-PV/electrical conversion, finite dynamic store, liquid transfer, air transfer, four distinct zone thermal states, and the valve structural obligation.
contract.opaque_mechanism: Readable but statically unmapped public containers use evaluator-run paired energy/state behavior plus independently established valve structure; candidate self-attestation is never accepted.
contract.missing_scenario_status: PARTIAL or FAIL at the top level, with dependent robustness metrics zero.
contract.aggregation: Strict weighted geometric cross-group total; no epsilon floor and no post-total cap.
